incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED · 2050006789 · Severity: P2 · routing_errors / dedicated-eu-west-1

maria_sre: seeing a spike of 502/503s on dedicated pool eu-west-1. Error rate ~18% for requests from Sable Medical accounts.

jay_oncall: oncall taking it. paging SRE rotation, will gather traces + timeline. tagging @rita_cs for customer comms.

rita_cs: thanks — Sable Med is on our enterprise roster. primary contacts: rachel@sablemed (AM), account-team-sable (cs Slack). We should prepare a short customer-facing update quickly.

oliver_se: any sign of model problems or infra? logs show connection resets from runtime g-12 nodes. tailing logs now.

maria_sre: repro steps: send request -> fiber 0x... -> 503 with "backend_flush". pattern correlates with autoscaler churn after midnight patch.

alex_platform: autoscaler triggered several pool resizes at ~2049996600..2049999800 due to a noisy job; some nodes didn't join properly. I’m rolling a hotfix to prevent immediate termination of warm nodes.

jay_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) disable aggressive autoscaling in eu-west-1 2) force drain unhealthy nodes 3) route critical customers to fallback pool (eu-west-1-fallback) 4) status page + customer comms. doing step 1 now.

maria_sre: applied autoscaler override -> set min_size=6, max_burst=0. monitoring. error rate down to ~6% but still above baseline.

oliver_se: starting routing rule update to move Sable Med to eu-west-1-fallback. will keep original model pinned. ETA ~8-10m.

eve_statuspage: Draft status page entry coming up.

rita_cs: customer email draft below. please keep it short. I can send to Sable contacts after we confirm mitigation.

-- CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT --
Subject: Service interruption affecting Sable Medical (eu-west-1) — temporary routing change
Hi Rachel / Sable team,
We’re investigating increased request failures affecting requests served from the eu-west-1 dedicated pool between 02:30–03:00 UTC. We’re routing your traffic to a fallback pool to reduce errors while we remediate. You may see slightly higher latency for a short period. No customer data was exposed. We’ll follow up when we’ve completed a full RCA.
If you prefer we can pause traffic or revert — let us know.
Thanks,
Redwood Support (Rita)
-- END DRAFT --

jay_oncall: looks good. hold send until routing finish confirmed. add a line about expected ETA ~20 minutes.

oliver_se: routing change complete. Sable traffic moved to eu-west-1-fallback at 2050007050. error rate for their tokens <1% now.

maria_sre: confirmed metrics recovered for Sable Med. broad error rate for eu-west-1 dropped to ~0.7% overall.

alex_platform: autoscaler fix deployed (prevent rapid churn) at 2050007105. will monitor for 1h before relaxing overrides.

rita_cs: sending notification now to primary contacts and account slack channel. cc'ing account team.

rita_cs: sent — Rachel acknowledged and asked for a brief status page blurb + RFC for timeout. they appreciated fast routing fallback. :thumbsup:

-- STATUS PAGE DRAFT (to publish) --
Summary: We experienced increased request failures in the eu-west-1 dedicated serving pool impacting a subset of enterprise customers (Sable Medical).
Impact: Some requests returned 502/503 errors or experienced higher latency during a window 02:30–03:00 UTC. A routing fallback was applied for affected accounts.
Current status: Mitigated — traffic routed to fallback pool, error rate returned to baseline.
Action: We have deployed a temporary autoscaler safeguard and are investigating root cause. A full post-incident report will be published with timeline and RCA.

-- INTERNAL COMM TEMPLATE --
Short summary for execs: Sable Medical experienced transient failures due to autoscaler churn in eu-west-1 causing node join failures. We mitigated by routing their traffic to a fallback pool and deploying an autoscaler safeguard. No data leak.
Who was paged: oncall (Jay), SRE (Maria), Platform (Alex), Solutions Eng (Oliver), CS (Rita).
Next steps: continue monitoring, run postmortem, propose autoscaler config change + harden node join path.

maria_sre: creating incident runner ticket and adding timeline + logs.

oliver_se: leaving a sticky note in the Sable account playbook: fallback routing used + contact timestamp.

jay_oncall: handing off monitoring to next oncall in 30m. tagging @alex_platform for longer term follow-up.

alex_platform: I’ll own the follow-up. will open a dedicated issue and prioritize the join-path fix.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT UPDATED · 2050007289 · Status: Mitigated · Severity: P2

maria_sre: great teamwork. Rita — please file the customer comms in the Sable ticket so it’s attached to the RCA.

rita_cs: on it. will add sent copy + timeline.

jay_oncall: closing thread for live ops. RCA + postmortem to follow.

(reacted with :tada:)
